description: This Java class 'Version2Header' fetches version information from an SVN repository, processes it, and generates a header file 'svnversion.h' with version and Git hash details.

classes.name: Version2Header
classes.description: Main class for generating a header file with version information sourced from SVN and Git hash.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that takes command line arguments, retrieves SVN info, and calls writeFile to generate header file.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Creates and writes version and Git hash information into svnversion.h header file.
